crossRefs.note: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.bsb: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
translations.kjv: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
translations.asv: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
